label: preparing
what: A private surprise/feast in the great hall for the mayor at 18:00 on day 1: eight lanterns, and 200 loaves of bread on the tables, with the mayor discreetly brought in under the pretext of an inspection/operations meeting. The baker knowingly supplied bread, but the record does not clearly establish the baker knew the celebratory surprise or its full purpose. The mayor was kept unaware of the real purpose, although told about a lighting inspection and later operations discussion; at the final record the surprise had not yet been revealed or the mayor fully brought inside. The innkeeper, builder, and freight were the coordinating participants.
